1385.notes: Physical verification is a tab of NUMERO Reality; it does not carry the name NUMERO VERIFY. A person starts a verification of fixed assets, of the stock of one location, of cash boxes or of documents on file. The sheet is prepared from what the books say; what was found is entered line by line (a result for assets and documents, a quantity for stock, an amount for cash); items left unchecked need a reason; completion raises an alert for each difference and changes nothing in the books. A sheet opened by mistake is cancelled with a reason while it is open: what was entered stays on it, nothing is raised from it, it cannot be opened again, and a completed sheet cannot be cancelled (tested in the database, T275, and in the sample engine, with a sheet of cash). Verification of assets and of cash is tested in the database and in the sample engine (T227 to T230). Preparing, filling and completing a sheet of stock or of documents has no automated test, so the status is IMPLEMENTED and not TESTED. For a document the verification records whether the document on file was located; the file is not examined. What a verification found reaches Reality: for assets through the history of each asset (see 575); for stock, cash and documents through the last completed sheet of each subject and place, which is counted in Reality health where every item on it was looked at or where it found items otherwise than the books say, and is a difference in the second case, measured by the size of what was found short or over (see 1459). A sheet that left items unchecked and found nothing otherwise is counted as neither and is named under what was not looked at. A case opened on a line of a sheet of stock, cash or documents is shown in Reality against the difference of that sheet, which then offers no second case; a case opened on a line of a sheet of assets is not shown against the difference of the asset, whose key names the asset and not the sheet. The engine is tested with sheets of stock, of cash and of documents made up for the test, and in the sample engine with a sheet of cash completed there and read by the loader of Reality.
